answer: A bonded witness lottery resists sybils: registering locks a stake that scales with how many identities hang from one root credential, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand deposits. Each epoch a random sample countersigns peers' heartbeats, and a signature contradicting an outage is slashable. Farming emissions then demands keeping every fake identity funded while payout per identity stays flat: cost rises, reward does not. Honest operators keep one ocean of work, one bond, one record; colluders lose their haven as audits widen, and the summit of the pool stays with verifiable labor.
